let best: number | null = null;
[3, 1, 2].forEach((value) => {
  if (best === null || value > best) best = value;
});
if (best !== null) console.log(best + 1, best * 2, best - 1, best < 5, -best, +best);

let count: number | null = null;
function setCount(): void {
  count = 3;
}
setCount();
if (count !== null) {
  let total = 10;
  total += count;
  console.log(total, count ** 2, count << 1, count & 1, ~count, count % 2);
  count++;
  console.log(count);
}

let big: bigint | null = null;
function setBig(): void {
  big = 5n;
}
setBig();
if (big !== null) console.log(big + 1n, big * 2n, big > 1n);

let label: string | null = null;
function setLabel(): void {
  label = "Ann";
}
setLabel();
if (label !== null) console.log(label + "!", `${label}?`);

let list: number[] | null = null;
function setList(): void {
  list = [4, 5];
}
setList();
if (list !== null) {
  const { length } = list;
  console.log(list[0], [...list], length);
}
